purpose: Correct the Phase 1 percentile-universe mismatch by transporting only cohort-relative 4for4-vs-LOG rank disagreement among exact matched current free agents.
cohort: current free agents with live board hasRealData=true
identity_rule: exact normalized name + current position + normalized current team
base_signal: within-position percentile of current LOG value across the full data-backed free-agent cohort
matched_log_signal: within-position percentile of current LOG value among only exact 4for4-matched free agents
matched_fourforfour_signal: within-position percentile of private 4for4 projected FF Pts among the exact same matched free agents
persisted_output_policy: aggregate diagnostics only; no raw provider rows, player-level provider projections, player-level percentiles, player-level deltas, provider ranks, or derived utility scores
